limitations: No new product is marked accepted or externally passed.

Full runtime/network/storage/accessibility/device gates remain with original product owners.
All newly hosted candidates are intentionally noindex; canonical/hreflang/sitemap do not override it.
CSS Grid uses a byte-verified packaging adapter; original Windows build/check remains a documented failure.
Worker routing shares the existing free account request allowance; no paid service enabled.
